extract_symbols_from_library: extract symbols from an ELF or Mach-O binary library file using extract_or_load
demangle_cpp_symbol: demangle a C++ mangled symbol name using c++filt via demangle_symbol
filter_stdlib_symbols: filter a list of symbols into stdlib and non-stdlib categories using filter_stdlib_symbols
check_stdlib_symbol: check if a symbol name belongs to the C++ standard library using is_stdlib_symbol_name
write_symbols_to_file: write a sorted list of symbols to a file or stdout using write_syms
